Stellar integration review caught a uint32 consistency level truncated to uint8 without overflow checking, suggested declaring it as uint8 so JSON values must fit, preferred a watcher method using chainId over a free function with an unset emitter chain, and argued for returning parsed values rather than a partially constructed MessagePublication that is hard to audit.
Test guidelines review argued that live calls are integration tests rather than unit tests and suggested sharpening the anti-pattern wording.

EVM temporary pause and freeze role review worked through the pauser/freezer interaction, asking for clarification of the claim that reverting would let a pauser detect or weaken a freeze, tightening the max-timestamp freeze documentation, and questioning the value of emitting an always-constant pauseExpiry.

Solana freezer and timed pause review required reverting rather than writing a shorter pause_expiry when new_expiry is less than the current expiry, and asked for intra-doc links and clearer pause/freeze documentation instead of inlined constants.

Channel-check linter enablement review approved the channel handling after Near comment updates and a rebase, asking whether XRPL changes should use nolint style and warning against embedding constants in documentation.
Freezer address addition to the SetPauserAddresses governance payload approved as a sensible extension consistent with the updated whitepaper.

testutils and TimeFromUnix refactor review agreed the redundant uint32-bound check deserves a defense-in-depth comment and noted the change also removes an int64 cast, then asked for more actionable comments elsewhere.

worm-cli Sui migration review asked for execFileSync instead of shell invocation because it is more resistant to command injection, required a realpath-based directory check on packagePath before invoking the tool, questioned merging stderr into stdout, and asked whether a quiet JSON output mode exists.
Wormchain docs review flagged a missing warning that the Governor must not operate during a sync or transactions get replayed and stuck, and asked for an explanation of an unvalued denomination.
Custom Sui gRPC header parsing review suggested replacing hand-written parsing with cobra's built-in key-value flag support.

Borsh library consolidation review identified that the new behavior no longer returns an error on trailing bytes, argued the previous stricter behavior was safer, and recommended a wrapper enforcing the reference implementation's trailing-byte rejection even if not currently exploitable.

XRPL NTT accountant review pointed at SDK helpers for common parsing operations, asked that untyped XRPL discriminator constants be moved into typed domains, requested spellcheck dictionary entries, and asked where the easy-to-forget registration boolean flips are tracked.
Robinhood chain mainnet env review suggested adding a descriptive header comment.
Integration-test compilation review pointed out that equivalent tests already exist in parse_test.go, avoiding duplication.
Tron mainnet chain config review checked tronscan and could not find anything at the configured contract address, asking whether it was deployed yet or a different explorer should be used.
Wormchain troubleshooting docs review asked for HTML-comment cspell ignore directives around specific sections rather than skipping the whole file.
Sui gRPC checkpoint size increase review asked for a permalink to the upstream source of the constant and an explanation of why the chosen limit is slightly larger than the referenced constant.
Sui release bump review confirmed the Dockerfile hash against the upstream release.
Moonbeam removal approved as free of problems provided tests pass.

SDK version bump review challenged the removal of IBC relayer tests because Gateway/Wormchain is still a live path, questioned dropping Btc and Moonbeam coverage, and asked for a red-green test of the build-cli workflow path filter.
Governor token list review questioned whether removal of a manual token added only weeks earlier was intended.

Sui transaction verifier parsing review proposed a dedicated Asset type and an enum containing exactly the native and wrapped values instead of string, since only those two values are meaningful to verification.

Accountant audit logic review asked for a log when an oversized message does not fail so the limit can be tuned, questioned whether oversized messages are submitted at all since the loop only covers batches, and requested narrower unsigned types for counted values.
